extensions.scope: Discriminated object: {kind: product, id: affiliate_agent|lottery} or {kind: platform, id: lottorito}
extensions.sourceeventid: UUID string; identity is composite with tenant and scope
extensions.traceparent: W3C Trace Context version 00; trace and parent-span identifiers are validated

event_envelope.trace_context: W3C Trace Context traceparent; trace_id is 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters
event_envelope.time_format: RFC3339 date-time; leap-second lexical form is accepted
event_envelope.validation_profile: CloudEvents 1.0 core attributes plus Lottorito-required extensions; extension attributes remain permitted

legacy_mappings.p02.product_id: Product scope only; existing shared value is non-canonical and must not be silently reinterpreted
legacy_mappings.p03d.provider_event_inbox: tenant_id + product_id + provider_id + provider_event_id; source_event_id is persisted in the same product scope
legacy_mappings.p05b.p05_inbox: tenant_id + consumer_name + source_event_id; missing product/scope dimension is an integration gap
legacy_mappings.p05b.p05_replay_cursor: tenant_id + consumer_name + aggregate_id; missing product/scope dimension is an integration gap
legacy_mappings.p06.correlation_map: tenant_id + scope_kind + scope_id + source_event_id composite; trace_id is persisted; P-09I validates the source event envelope before correlation
legacy_mappings.p06.product_domain: affiliate_agent|lottery|platform; platform must map to platform scope, never to a product id
legacy_mappings.p07b.event_contracts: source_product and allowed_consumers map to product scope; dispatch enforces sourceeventid, schemaversion and traceparent through the shared P-09 validator
legacy_mappings.p08.artifact: P-09I binds the canonical product scope object and canonical product registry into release metadata and detached provenance

migration_rules: Never collapse shared and platform into a product identifier.
Never infer product identity from payload fields or caller-controlled event data.
Never use a bare UUID as a globally unique event, effect, journal, or correlation key.
Financial effects and journals must always belong to exactly one product scope.
Platform-scoped events cannot create financial effects or journals.
Legacy rows without an unambiguous product/scope mapping must be quarantined for reconciliation, not guessed.
